hero.text: Explore Tirupati, plan your Tirumala pilgrimage, and travel comfortably with Yatra Travels.

faqs.q: Do you provide TTD darshan tickets?
faqs.a: No. Yatra Travels is a transport and tour operator. Darshan tickets are issued by TTD through its official website and counters. Book them yourself, and we plan your transport around your slot.

faqs.q: Is my booking confirmed when I submit the form?
faqs.a: Not yet. The form sends a booking request and gives you a reference number. We check vehicle availability, confirm the price with you by phone or WhatsApp, and only then is the trip confirmed.

faqs.q: Can you pick us up at Tirupati Airport or Renigunta Junction?
faqs.a: Yes. Share your flight or train details when you book and the driver will plan around your arrival.

faqs.q: Are prices per person or per vehicle?
faqs.a: Per vehicle. The price depends on the vehicle, distance and duration, not on the number of passengers, within the vehicle's seating capacity.
